column1: # Cipher between Giacomo Guicciardini (secretary of the Grand Duke of Tuscany) and Sillery, 1593 -- Tomokiyo's table after Speziali (1955), 'Aspects de la Cryptographie au XVIe Siecle', BHR XVII.
# Credit: reconstruction Speziali 1955; table and arrangement S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana (cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/guicciardini.htm). Rule 8: cited, transcribed for screening only.

# Transcription TUSC-KEYS (14 Oct 2026, account 2): two blind Sonnet passes over the whole image (831x539 typeset table, the image is its own crop) agree on all 54 printed numbers; my own read agrees. Grade H-published = value printed in the published table (a modern published reconstruction, not a period key sheet); M = placement interpreted.

# Not printed (blank in the table): x y z, cu du ru lu mu su tu, do, ir, es os, en in. Ciphertext design per Tomokiyo: continuous figures, two-figure units for letters and syllables, three-figure code elements (none in this table).
# 33 sits alone in a second row under the 'a' column (no heading of its own): read as a second figure for a, grade M.
# office: Grand Duke of Tuscany's secretariat (Giacomo Guicciardini, secretary)
# key_source: published (Speziali 1955; table S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana guicciardini.htm)
# home: none (screening table for ciphers/fr3982-nevers-toscana-1592; kept here so that folder's own keys keep their office metadata)
